```{r Data Summarization Script for GAM_MCS, include=TRUE, warning=FALSE,fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr) #has the function str_detect()
library(patchwork) #For printing grids of ggplot
library(ggplot2)
library(dunn.test)
library(ggpubr) 
library(pracma)

{
setwd("enter/working/directory/file/path") #Change this to actual directory
  
  SMA <- vector("list")
  type <- vector ("list")
  age <- vector("list")
  city <- vector("list")
  data_list <- list()
  
  fval_list <- c('InfAF','NoroF','EVF')
  metric_list <-c('mean_dev','mean_edf') #,'sd_dev','IQR')
  metric_name_list <- c('Deviance Explained','Effective Degrees of Freedom') #,'Standard Deviation','Interquartile Range')
  group_list <- c('SMA','age','type','city')
  file_matches <- list.files(pattern = ".*_GAM-values.xlsx|.*_GAM-metrics.xlsx", full.names = TRUE)
  file_matchesMCS <- list.files(pattern = ".*_GAM-Stochastic.xlsx", full.names = TRUE)
  file_names <- gsub("\\.xlsx$", "", basename(file_matches))
  
  
  #Extracts data from excel files
  for (file in file_matches) {
    df <- read_excel(file, col_names = TRUE)
    for (col in names(df)) {
      if (nrow(df) == 0) {
        zero_row <- data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(df)))
        colnames(zero_row) <- colnames(df)
        df <- zero_row
      }
    }
    data_list[[basename(file)]] <- df
  }
  for (file in file_matchesMCS){
    fileMCS <- paste0(substr(file, start = 3, stop = nchar(file) - 16),"metrics.xlsx")
    corresponding_metrics <- data_list[str_detect(names(data_list),pattern=fileMCS)]
    if (length(corresponding_metrics) != 0){
      offset <- as.character(corresponding_metrics[[1]]$Offset)
      devexpl <- corresponding_metrics[[1]]$DevianceExplained
      if (devexpl != 0){  
        if (length(offset) != 0){
          df <- read_excel(file, col_names = TRUE, sheet = offset)
          data_list[[basename(file)]] <- df
        }
      }
    }
  } 
  values_data <- data_list[str_detect(names(data_list), pattern = ".*_GAM-values")]
  dfs_list <- vector("list", length(values_data))
  
  #Pools and organizes data sheets
  for (i in seq_along(names(values_data))) {
    filename <- names(values_data[i])
    prefix <- substr(filename, start = 1, stop = nchar(filename) - 16)
    col_name <- colnames(values_data[[i]])[2]
    if (nrow(values_data[[i]]!=0)){
      observed_df <- values_data[[i]] %>%
        select(!!sym(col_name)) %>%
        mutate(filename = filename)
      
      dfs_list[[i]] <- observed_df
      
      file_to_combine <- paste(substr(filename,1,nchar(filename)-11),"metrics.xlsx",sep="")
      file_to_combineMCS <- paste(substr(filename,1,nchar(filename)-11),"Stochastic.xlsx",sep="")
      
      data_list[[file_to_combine]]$NRMSE <- data_list[[file_to_combine]]$RMSE/(max(observed_df[,1])-min(observed_df[,1]))
      data_list[[file_to_combine]]$file <- file_to_combine
      data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]]$file <- file_to_combineMCS
      
      data_list[[file_to_combine]] <- data_list[[file_to_combine]] %>%
        filter(!is.na(data_list[[file_to_combine]]$AICc))
      
      data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]] <- data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]] %>%
        filter(!is.na(data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]]$mean_dev))
      
      if (grepl("xd",filename)){
        SMA[["xd_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(SMA[["xd_Metrics"]],data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        SMA[["xd_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(SMA[["xd_MCS"]],data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      } 
      if (grepl("xxd",filename)){
        SMA[["xxd_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(SMA[["xxd_Metrics"]],data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        SMA[["xxd_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(SMA[["xxd_MCS"]],data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      } 
      if (grepl("xxxd",filename)){
        SMA[["xxxd_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(SMA[["xxxd_Metrics"]],data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        SMA[["xxxd_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(SMA[["xxxd_MCS"]],data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      }
      if (grepl("agegroup1",filename)){
        age[["agegroup1_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(age[["agegroup1_Metrics"]],data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        age[["agegroup1_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(age[["agegroup1_MCS"]],data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      } 
      if (grepl("agegroup2",filename)){
        age[["agegroup2_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(age[["agegroup2_Metrics"]],data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        age[["agegroup2_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(age[["agegroup2_MCS"]],data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      } 
      if (grepl("agegroup3",filename)){
        age[["agegroup3_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(age[["agegroup3_Metrics"]],data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        age[["agegroup3_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(age[["agegroup3_MCS"]],data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      }
      if (grepl("percent",filename)){
        type[["prevelance_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(type[["prevelance_Metrics"]],data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        type[["prevelance_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(type[["prevelance_MCS"]],data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      } 
      if (grepl("percentchange",filename)){
        type[["datatype1_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(type[["datatype1_Metrics"]],data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        type[["datatype1_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(type[["datatype1_MCS"]],data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      } 
      if (grepl("Cityname2",filename)){
        city[["Cityname2_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(city[["Cityname2_Metrics"]],data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        city[["Cityname2_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(city[["Cityname2_MCS"]],data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      } 
      if (grepl("Cityname1",filename)){
        city[["Cityname1_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(city[["Cityname1_Metrics"]],data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        city[["Cityname1_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(city[["Cityname1_MCS"]],data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
        
        
      }
    }
  }
  #####MCS Results
  A_list <- c('x-day SMA','agegroup1','percent','Cityname2')
  A <- list('SMA$xd_MCS' = SMA$`xd_MCS`,'age$agegroup1_MCS' = age$agegroup1_MCS,"type$prevelance_MCS" = type$prevelance_MCS, "city$Cityname2_MCS" = city$Cityname2_MCS)
  A <- A[!sapply(A, is.null)]
  B_list <- c('xx-day SMA','agegroup2','percentchange','Cityname1')
  B <- list('SMA$xxd_MCS' = SMA$`xxd_MCS`,'age$agegroup2_MCS' = age$agegroup2_MCS,"type$datatype1_MCS" = type$datatype1_MCS, "city$Cityname1_MCS" = city$Cityname1_MCS)
  B <- B[!sapply(B, is.null)]
  C_list <-c('xxx-day SMA','agegroup3',"type3",'city3')
  C <- list('SMA$xxxd_MCS' = SMA$`xxxd_MCS`,'age$agegroup3_MCS' = age$agegroup3_MCS,"type$prevelance_MCS" = type$prevelance_MCS, "city$Cityname2_MCS" = city$Cityname2_MCS) 
  C <- C[!sapply(C, is.null)]
  
  
  #condense reporting of slope/y_cross to print from one if statement and insert metric into print statement too
  for (g in 1:length(group_list)) {
    i<-1
    
    for (metric in (metric_list)) {  
      
      
      calc_summary <- function(df, metric) {
        df %>%
          group_by(noise_level) %>%
          summarise(
            mean_metric = mean(.data[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_metric = sd(.data[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE),
            n = sum(!is.na(.data[[metric]]))
          ) %>%
          mutate(
            se = sd_metric / sqrt(n),
            ci_lower = mean_metric - qt(0.975, n-1) * se,
            ci_upper = mean_metric + qt(0.975, n-1) * se
          )
      }
      
      df <- df %>%
        filter(!is.na(df$noise_level))
      if (metric == "mean_dev") {
        ymin <- 0
        ymax <- 1
        mid <- 0.5
      } else if (metric == "sd_dev") {
        ymin <- 0
        ymax <- 0.15
        mid <- 0.075
      } else if (metric == "IQR") {
        ymin <- 0
        ymax <- 0.25
        mid <- 0.1
      } else if (metric == "mean_edf") {
        ymin <- 0
        ymax <- 20
        mid <- -8 
      }
      
      {
        #compute summaries for all three SMA windows once
        SMA_xd_summary <- lapply(A[g], calc_summary, metric = metric) 
        SMA_xxd_summary <- lapply(B[g], calc_summary, metric = metric)
        SMA_xxxd_summary <- lapply(C[g], calc_summary, metric = metric)
        
        SMA_xd_summary <- SMA_xd_summary[[1]]
        SMA_xxd_summary <- SMA_xxd_summary[[1]]
        SMA_xxxd_summary <- SMA_xxxd_summary[[1]]
        
        #If any of the summaries are empty (safety), create an empty tibble to prevent errors
        if (nrow(SMA_xd_summary) == 0) SMA_xd_summary <- tibble(noise_level = numeric(0), mean_metric = numeric(0), ci_lower = numeric(0), ci_upper = numeric(0))
        if (nrow(SMA_xxd_summary) == 0) SMA_xxd_summary <- tibble(noise_level = numeric(0), mean_metric = numeric(0), ci_lower = numeric(0), ci_upper = numeric(0))
        if (nrow(SMA_xxxd_summary) == 0) SMA_xxxd_summary <- tibble(noise_level = numeric(0), mean_metric = numeric(0), ci_lower = numeric(0), ci_upper = numeric(0))
        
        SMA_xd_summary <- na.omit(SMA_xd_summary)
        SMA_xxd_summary <- na.omit(SMA_xxd_summary)
        SMA_xxxd_summary <- na.omit(SMA_xxxd_summary)
        
        #x-day plot 
        SMAxd_line <- lm(SMA_xd_summary$mean_metric~SMA_xd_summary$noise_level)
        coef_vals_xd <- coef(SMAxd_line)
        intercept_xd <- coef_vals_xd[1]
        slope_xd <- coef_vals_xd[2]
        
        y_cross0.5_xd <- (mid - intercept_xd) / slope_xd
        y_cross0.5_xd 
        
        plot_SMAxd <- ggplot(SMA_xd_summary, aes(x = noise_level, y = mean_metric)) +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
          geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), fill = "#D40000", alpha = 0.2) +
          geom_point(color = "#D40000") +
          geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = mid, xend = 1, yend = mid), 
                       linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.4) +  #horizontal dashed line
          scale_x_continuous(
            name = "Relative % Noise", 
            limits = c(0, 1),
            breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
          ) +
          labs(
            title = paste0("Mean ", metric_name_list[i], " \n- ",A_list[g]),
            y = paste0("Mean ", metric_name_list[i])
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          ylim(ymin, ymax)
        
        
        #xx-day plot
        SMAxxd_line <- lm(SMA_xxd_summary$mean_metric~SMA_xxd_summary$noise_level)
        coef_vals_xxd <- coef(SMAxxd_line)
        intercept_xxd <- coef_vals_xxd[1]
        slope_xxd <- coef_vals_xxd[2]
        
        y_cross0.5_xxd <- (mid - intercept_xxd) / slope_xxd
        y_cross0.5_xxd <- round(y_cross0.5_xxd, 2)
        
        plot_SMAxxd <- ggplot(SMA_xxd_summary, aes(x = noise_level, y = mean_metric)) +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
          geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), fill = "#8A040D", alpha = 0.2) +
          #geom_line(color = "#8A040D") +
          geom_point(color = "#8A040D") +
          geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = mid, xend = 1, yend = mid), 
                       linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.4) +  
          scale_x_continuous(
            name = "Relative % Noise", 
            limits = c(0, 1),
            breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
          ) +
          labs(
            title = paste0("Mean ", metric_name_list[i], " \n- ",B_list[g]),
            y = paste0("Mean ", metric_name_list[i])
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          ylim(ymin, ymax)
        
        
        #xxx-day plot 
        SMAxxxd_line <- lm(SMA_xxxd_summary$mean_metric~SMA_xxxd_summary$noise_level)
        coef_vals_xxxd <- coef(SMAxxxd_line)
        intercept_xxxd <- coef_vals_xxxd[1]
        slope_xxxd <- coef_vals_xxxd[2]
        
        y_cross0.5_xxxd <- (mid - intercept_xxxd) / slope_xxxd
        y_cross0.5_xxxd 
        
        plot_SMAxxxd <- ggplot(SMA_xxxd_summary, aes(x = noise_level, y = mean_metric)) +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
          geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), fill = "#330000", alpha = 0.2) +
          #geom_line(color = "#330000") +
          geom_point(color = "#330000") +
          geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = mid, xend = 1, yend = mid), 
                       linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.4) +  #horizontal dashed line
          scale_x_continuous(
            name = "Relative % Noise", 
            limits = c(0, 1),
            breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
          ) +
          labs(
            title = paste0("Mean ", metric_name_list[i], " \n- ",C_list[g]),
            y = paste0("Mean ", metric_name_list[i])
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          ylim(ymin, ymax)
        
        if(C_list[g] == "xxx-day SMA" || C_list[g] == "agegroup3"){
          print(plot_SMAxd + plot_SMAxxd + plot_SMAxxxd)
          if (metric == "mean_dev"){
            print(paste0("For ", A_list[g],", Relative % Noise = ", round(y_cross0.5_xd, 2),", when ",metric," = ",mid))
            print(paste0("For ", B_list[g],", Relative % Noise = ", round(y_cross0.5_xxd, 2),", when ",metric," = ",mid))
            print(paste0("For ", C_list[g],", Relative % Noise = ", round(y_cross0.5_xxxd, 2),", when ",metric," = ",mid))
          } else {
            print(paste0("For ", A_list[g],", Slope = ",round(slope_xd,2)))
            print(paste0("For ", B_list[g],", Slope = ",round(slope_xxd,2)))
            print(paste0("For ", C_list[g],", Slope = ",round(slope_xxxd,2)))
          }        
          
          
        } else {
          print(plot_SMAxd + plot_SMAxxd)
          if (metric == "mean_dev"){
            print(paste0("For ", A_list[g],", Relative % Noise = ", round(y_cross0.5_xd, 2),", when ",metric," = ",mid))
            print(paste0("For ", B_list[g],", Relative % Noise = ", round(y_cross0.5_xxd, 2),", when ",metric," = ",mid))
          } else {
            print(paste0("For ", A_list[g],", Slope = ",round(slope_xd,2)))
            print(paste0("For ", B_list[g],", Slope = ",round(slope_xxd,2)))
          }  
          
        }
      }
      
      i<-i+1
    }
  }
  print("-------------------------------- Stochastic Simulation Results End here --------------------------------")
  #Boxplots for SMA Deviance explained
  {
    SMAdev_df <- tibble(
      value = c(SMA$'xd_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`,
                SMA$'xxd_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`,
                SMA$'xxxd_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`),
      
      SMA = c(rep("x-day", length(SMA$'xd_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`)),
              rep("xx-day", length(SMA$'xxd_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`)),
              rep("xxx-day", length(SMA$'xxxd_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`)))
    )
    
    kruskal_test_SMAdev <- kruskal.test(value ~ SMA, data = SMAdev_df)
    if (kruskal_test_SMAdev$p.value<0.05){
      dunn_result_SMAdev <- dunn.test(
        x = SMAdev_df$value,
        g = SMAdev_df$SMA,
        method = "bonferroni")
      print(paste("SMA deviance explained dunn test results: ",dunn_result_SMAdev))
    } else {
      print(paste("SMA shows no significant difference for deviance explained, p-value =",kruskal_test_SMAdev$p.value))
    }
    SMAdev_df <- SMAdev_df %>%
      filter(SMAdev_df$value > 0)
    SMAplot <- ggplot(SMAdev_df, aes(x = SMA, y = value)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      labs(
        title = "Deviance Explained by various SMA",
        x = "Simple Moving Average (SMA) Window",
        y = "Deviance Explained"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "dashed", size = 0.5, color = "gray90"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.5),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "lines"),
      ) + ylim(0,1)
    
    print(SMAplot)
  }
  #Boxplots for SMA NRMSE
  {
    SMA2NRMSE_df <- tibble(
      value = c(SMA$'xd_Metrics'$`NRMSE`,
                SMA$'xxd_Metrics'$`NRMSE`,
                SMA$'xxxd_Metrics'$`NRMSE`),
      
      SMA = c(rep("x-day", length(SMA$'xd_Metrics'$`NRMSE`)),
              rep("xx-day", length(SMA$'xxd_Metrics'$`NRMSE`)),
              rep("xxx-day", length(SMA$'xxxd_Metrics'$`NRMSE`)))
    )
    
    kruskal_test_SMA2NRMSE <- kruskal.test(value ~ SMA, data = SMA2NRMSE_df)
    if (kruskal_test_SMA2NRMSE$p.value<0.05){
      dunn_result_SMA2NRMSE <- dunn.test(
        x = SMA2NRMSE_df$value,
        g = SMA2NRMSE_df$SMA2,
        method = "bonferroni")
      print(paste("SMA NRMSE dunn test results: ",dunn_result_SMA2NRMSE))
    } else {
      print(paste("SMA shows no significant difference for NRMSE, p-value =",kruskal_test_SMA2NRMSE$p.value))
    }
    SMA2NRMSE_df <- SMA2NRMSE_df %>%
      filter(SMA2NRMSE_df$value > 0)
    SMA2plot <- ggplot(SMA2NRMSE_df, aes(x = SMA, y = value)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      labs(
        title = "NRMSE by various SMA",
        x = "Simple Moving Average (SMA) Window",
        y = "NRMSE"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "dashed", size = 0.5, color = "gray90"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.5),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "lines"),
      ) + ylim(0,0.2)
    
    print(SMA2plot)
  }
  #Boxplots for SMA Optimal offset
  {
    SMAoff_df<- tibble(
      dev = c(SMA$'xd_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`,
              SMA$'xxd_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`,
              SMA$'xxxd_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`),
      value = c(SMA$'xd_Metrics'$`Offset`,
                SMA$'xxd_Metrics'$`Offset`,
                SMA$'xxxd_Metrics'$`Offset`),
      SMA = c(rep("x-day", length(SMA$'xd_Metrics'$`Offset`)),
              rep("xx-day", length(SMA$'xxd_Metrics'$`Offset`)),
              rep("xxx-day", length(SMA$'xxxd_Metrics'$`Offset`)))
    )
    
    kruskal_test_SMAoff <- kruskal.test(value ~ SMA, data = SMAoff_df)
    if (kruskal_test_SMAoff$p.value<0.05){
      dunn_result_SMAoff <- dunn.test(
        x = SMAoff_df$value,
        g = SMAoff_df$SMA,
        method = "bonferroni")
      print(paste("SMA optimal offset dunn test results: ",dunn_result_SMAoff))
    } else {
      print(paste("SMA shows no significant difference for optimal offset, p-value =",kruskal_test_SMAoff$p.value))
    }
    SMAoff_df <- SMAoff_df %>%
      filter(SMAoff_df$dev > 0)
    SMA3plot <- ggplot(SMAoff_df, aes(x = SMA, y = value)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      labs(
        title = "Optimal offset using various SMA",
        x = "Simple Moving Average (SMA) Window",
        y = "Optimal offset"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "dashed", size = 0.5, color = "gray90"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.5),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "lines"),
      ) + ylim(-11,11)
    
    print(SMA3plot)
  }
  
  #Boxplots for Age Deviance explained
  {
    agedev_df <- tibble(
      value = c(age$'agegroup1_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`,
                age$'agegroup2_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`,
                age$'agegroup3_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`),
      
      age = c(rep("agegroup1", length(age$'agegroup1_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`)),
              rep("agegroup2", length(age$'agegroup2_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`)),
              rep("agegroup3", length(age$'agegroup3_Metrics'$`DevianceExplained`)))
    )
    
    kruskal_test_agedev <- kruskal.test(value ~ age, data = agedev_df)
    if (kruskal_test_agedev$p.value<0.05){
      dunn_result_agedev <- dunn.test(
        x = agedev_df$value,
        g = agedev_df$age,
        method = "bonferroni")
      print(paste("age group and deviance explained dunn test results: ",dunn_result_agedev))
    } else {
      print(paste("age group shows no significant difference for deviance explained, p-value =",kruskal_test_agedev$p.value))

  #SMA F values
  {
    for (fval_name in fval_list){
      pval_name <- paste0(substr(fval_name, 1, nchar(fval_name) - 1),"Pval")
      fval_df <- tibble(
        value = (c(
          SMA$'xd_Metrics'[[fval_name]],
          SMA$'xxd_Metrics'[[fval_name]],
          SMA$'xxxd_Metrics'[[fval_name]])),
        pval = c(
          SMA$'xd_Metrics'[[pval_name]],
          SMA$'xxd_Metrics'[[pval_name]],
          SMA$'xxxd_Metrics'[[pval_name]]),
        SMA = c(
          rep("x-day", length(SMA$'xd_Metrics'$'DevianceExplained')),
          rep("xx-day", length(SMA$'xxd_Metrics'$'DevianceExplained')),
          rep("xxx-day", length(SMA$'xxxd_Metrics'$'DevianceExplained')))
      )
      
      plot(fval_df$value, fval_df$pval,
           main = "Scatter Plot of F-value vs p-value",
           xlab = "F-value",
           ylab = "p-value",
           pch = 16) 
      
      
      #Kruskal-Wallis test
      kruskal_test <- kruskal.test(value ~ SMA, data = fval_df)
      
      #Perform Dunn's test if significant
      if (kruskal_test$p.value < 0.05) {
        dunn_result <- dunn.test(
          x = fval_df$value,
          g = fval_df$SMA,
          method = "bonferroni"
        )
        print(paste("Significant difference in F-value of", fval_name, "via Dunn's test:", dunn_result$P.adjusted))
      } else {
        print(paste("No significant difference in F-value of", fval_name, "p-value =", kruskal_test$p.value))
      }
      
      fval_df <- fval_df %>%
        filter(value > 0)
      
      fval_summary <- fval_df %>%
        group_by(SMA) %>%
        summarise(
          median_f = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
          n = n(),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(
          median_f = round(median_f, 3)
        )
      
      
      cat("\nSummary: F-values for", fval_name, "by SMA window \n")
      print(fval_summary)
      
      #actual plot
      plot <- ggplot(fval_df, aes(x = SMA, y = value)) +
        geom_boxplot() +
        labs(
          title = paste0(fval_name, "-values by various SMA windows"),
          x = "Simple Moving Average (SMA) Window",
          y = "F-value"
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
          axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "dashed", size = 0.5, color = "gray90"),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.5),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
          plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "lines"),
        ) + 
        ylim(0, 75)
      
      print(plot)
    }
  }

  }
  
  #type F values
  {
    for (fval_name in fval_list){
      
      
      pval_name <- paste0(substr(fval_name, 1, nchar(fval_name) - 1),"Pval")
      fval_df <- tibble(
        value = (c(
          type$'prevelance_Metrics'[[fval_name]],
          type$'datatype1_Metrics'[[fval_name]])),
        pval = c(
          type$'prevelance_Metrics'[[pval_name]],
          type$'datatype1_Metrics'[[pval_name]]),
        type = c(
          rep("Prevelance", length(type$'prevelance_Metrics'$'DevianceExplained')),
          rep("datatype1", length(type$'datatype1_Metrics'$'DevianceExplained')))
      )
      
      plot(fval_df$value, fval_df$pval,
           main = "Scatter Plot of F-value vs p-value",
           xlab = "F-value",
           ylab = "p-value",
           pch = 16) 
      
      #Kruskal-Wallis test
      kruskal_test <- kruskal.test(value ~ type, data = fval_df)
      
      #Perform Dunn's test if significant
      if (kruskal_test$p.value < 0.05) {
        dunn_result <- dunn.test(
          x = fval_df$value,
          g = fval_df$type,
          method = "bonferroni"
        )
        print(paste("Significant difference in F-value of", fval_name, "via Dunn's test:", dunn_result$P.adjusted))
      } else {
        print(paste("No significant difference in F-value of", fval_name, "p-value =", kruskal_test$p.value))
      }
      
      fval_df <- fval_df %>%
        filter(value > 0)
      fval_summary <- fval_df %>%
        group_by(type) %>%
        summarise(
          median_f = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
          n = n(),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(
          median_f = round(median_f, 3)
        )
      
      
      cat("\nSummary: F-values for", fval_name, "by Type \n")
      print(fval_summary)
      
      #actual plot
      plot <- ggplot(fval_df, aes(x = type, y = value)) +
        geom_boxplot() +
        labs(
          title = paste0(fval_name, "-values by various absenteeism types"),
          x = "Type",
          y = "F-value"
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
          axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),

          legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
          plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "lines"),
        ) + 
        ylim(0, 75)
      print(plot)
    }
  }

  #All F-values
  value_tmp <- double()

  virus_tmp <- character()
  cat_tmp <- character()
  
  categories <- c(
    "Cityname2", "Cityname1",

    "SMA_xd", "SMA_xxd", "SMA_xxxd",
    "agegroup1", "agegroup2", "agegroup3"
  )
  
  for (fval_name in fval_list){
    pval_name <- paste0(substr(fval_name, 1, nchar(fval_name) - 1),"Pval")
    
    values <- list(
      city$'Cityname2_Metrics'[[fval_name]],
      city$'Cityname1_Metrics'[[fval_name]],
      type$'prevelance_Metrics'[[fval_name]],
      type$'datatype1_Metrics'[[fval_name]],
      SMA$'xd_Metrics'[[fval_name]],
      SMA$'xxd_Metrics'[[fval_name]],

    for (i in seq_along(values)) {

      pval_tmp <- c(pval_tmp, pvals[[i]])
      virus_tmp <- c(virus_tmp, rep(fval_name, n_i))

    print(length(value_tmp))
    print(length(pval_tmp))
    print(length(virus_tmp))
  }
  
  fval_df <- tibble(

  )
  
  plot(fval_df$value, fval_df$pval,
       main = "Scatter Plot of F-value vs p-value",
       xlab = "F-value",
       ylab = "p-value",
       pch = 16) 
  
  #Kruskal-Wallis test
  kruskal_test <- kruskal.test(value ~ virus, data = fval_df)
  
  #Perform Dunn's test if significant
  if (kruskal_test$p.value < 0.05) {
    dunn_result <- dunn.test(
      x = fval_df$value,

    )
    print(paste("Significant difference in F-values via Dunn's test:", dunn_result$P.adjusted))
  } else {

  virus_colours <- c("Enterovirus" = "red", "Influenza A" = "purple", "Norovirus GII" = "green")
  fval_df$virus <- recode(

  print(plot)
  
  
  print(SMAplot+ageplot+typeplot+cityplot)

  min_NRMSE <- data.frame()
  min_NRMSE <- data_list[[1]] %>%
    select(file,NRMSE)
  high_cross <- 0
  max_devexpl <- data_list[[1]] %>%
    select(file,DevianceExplained)
  for (list in names(data_list)){
    all_NRMSE <- data_list[[list]][["NRMSE"]]
    devexpl <- data_list[[list]][["DevianceExplained"]]
    sim <- data_list[[list]][["noise_level"]]
    
    if (!is.null(all_NRMSE)){
      if (all_NRMSE<min_NRMSE$NRMSE){
        min_NRMSE$NRMSE <- all_NRMSE
        min_NRMSE$file <- list
      }
      if (devexpl>max_devexpl$DevianceExplained){
        max_devexpl$DevianceExplained <- devexpl
        max_devexpl$file <- list
      }
    }
    if(!is.null(sim)){
      devsim <- data_list[[list]] %>%
        select(file,noise_level,mean_dev)
      devsim_line <- lm(devsim$mean_dev~devsim$noise_level)
      coef_vals_devsim <- coef(devsim_line)
      intercept_devsim <- coef_vals_devsim[1]
      slope_devsim <- coef_vals_devsim[2]
      
      y_cross0.5_devsim <- round((0.5 - intercept_devsim) / slope_devsim,2)
      if (y_cross0.5_devsim>high_cross){
        best_sim <- devsim
        best_sim$cross <- y_cross0.5_devsim
      }
    }
  }
}
print(min_NRMSE)
print(max_devexpl)
print(paste0(unique(best_sim$file)," crossing 50% deviance explained at ",unique(best_sim$cross)))
```
